title: Example Blog: v1.0 Launch Update
summary: This example shows how to write a local blog post with headings, lists, and images stored in the blogs folder.
author: Modpack Team

content.text: Welcome to the first update post. This post is loaded from blogs/example-launch-update.json so your site can keep blog content in files.

items: Support for cover images per post

content.caption: Place your screenshots in blogs/images and reference them with relative paths.

content.text: To add another post, copy this JSON file, change the text/images, and add the file path to blogs/index.json.
